mapper.select: WITH lock_acquired AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(#{lockKey}, 0)) ) SELECT 1 FROM lock_acquired
SELECT * FROM ainer_identity_tenant_provisioning_request WHERE id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ainer_identity_activation_grant WHERE id = #{grantId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM ainer_identity_tenant_provisioning_request WHERE status = 'REQUESTED' AND ( tenant_code = #{tenantCode} OR (owner_username = #{ownerUsername} AND owner_user_exists = false) ) ORDER BY requested_at, id FOR UPDATE
SELECT id AS subject_id, username, display_name, status FROM ainer_identity_user WHERE username = #{username} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id AS subject_id, username, display_name, status FROM ainer_identity_user WHERE id = #{subjectId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_identity_tenant_provisioning_request ( id, tenant_id, tenant_code, tenant_name, owner_subject_id, owner_username, owner_display_name, owner_user_exists, status, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, requested_by_service_id, request_id, change_reference, requested_at, expires_at, completed_at, version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{tenantCode}, #{tenantName}, #{ownerSubjectId}, #{ownerUsername}, #{ownerDisplayName}, #{ownerUserExists}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{requestedByServiceId}, #{requestId}, #{changeReference}, #{requestedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{completedAt}, #{version} )

INSERT INTO ainer_identity_notification_outbox ( id, provisioning_request_id, tenant_id, subject_id, notification_type, template_version, payload_key_version, protected_payload, publication_status, attempt_count, available_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{notification.id}, #{notification.provisioningRequestId}, #{notification.tenantId}, #{notification.subjectId}, #{notification.notificationType}, #{notification.templateVersion}, #{notification.payloadKeyVersion}, #{notification.protectedPayload}, 'PENDING', 0, #{availableAt}, #{notification.createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ainer_identity_tenant_provisioning_request SET status = 'EXPIRED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'REQUESTED' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE ainer_identity_tenant_provisioning_request SET status = 'ACTIVATED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'REQUESTED' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE ainer_identity_tenant_provisioning_request SET status = 'CANCELLED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'REQUESTED' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE ainer_identity_activation_grant SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_attempt_at = #{lastAttemptAt}, status = CASE WHEN #{lockGrant} THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE status END WHERE id = #{grantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND attempt_count = #{expectedAttemptCount} AND attempt_count < max_attempts

UPDATE ainer_identity_notification_outbox SET publication_status = 'CANCELLED', payload_key_version = 'destroyed', protected_payload = decode(repeat('00', 32), 'hex'), payload_destroyed_at = statement_timestamp(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL WHERE provisioning_request_id = #{requestId} AND publication_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
